description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Join a very small engineering group as an early hire, working across the front end, back end and infrastructure of a customer-facing software product. You will ship features, diagnose production issues and help set technical standards for future engineers. Expect broad ownership with little prescribed structure.
 What you'll do
 - Build and ship features across the full stack, from user interface to backend services.
 - Develop and refine systems built on large language models, including conversation flow, tool use and voice.
 - Prototype adaptive interface components and turn ideas into working demos quickly.
 - Build and maintain an evaluation pipeline that measures output quality and catches regressions.
 - Investigate production issues by reviewing logs, tracing root causes, rolling back changes and adding tests.
 - Design infrastructure for versioning and safe previewing of changes before release.
 - Create low-latency, reliable infrastructure so users get instant responses.
 - Take on whatever work is needed, including UI fixes, data migration scripts and customer issue debugging.
 - Help establish engineering culture and practices as the team grows.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Prior full stack engineering work at a growing software startup that has paying users.
 - A track record of designing polished interfaces and shipping product features that users directly interact with.
 - Working proficiency in React and Python.
 - Hands-on delivery of AI-powered features in production, such as LLM-driven assistants, retrieval pipelines or orchestration layers.
 - A bachelor's degree in computer science.
 - Comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership.
 - Good product instincts and enthusiasm for turning user feedback into code.
 - Sound judgment about when work is ready to ship, and the ability to move quickly without creating hidden problems.
 - Experience running systems that real users depend on, and an understanding of how they fail.
 - Interest in closing the gap between a demo and a reliable production system through evaluation and iteration.
 Bonus points
 - Experience at a sales technology startup.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 230,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
